title: Technology Sector Update for 01/11/2019: HIMX,AAPL,ATVI - Nasdaq.com
text:

Technology stocks were slightly lower as a group on Friday, with the shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 losing about 0.6% in value, although the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising 1.1% in recent trading.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(-) Himax Technologies ( HIMX ) has little changed this afternoon, giving back a more than 6% advance that followed the fabless chipmaker saying it secured a significant design win for in-cell touch and display driver integration with a "major" South Korean smartphone maker. The company expects to begin shipments under the award in Q1.
In other sector news:
(-) Apple ( AAPL ) was down 1.4% on Friday after The Wall Street Journal reported that the company is preparing to launch three new iPhone models later this year despite recently slashing its revenue forecast following sub-par demand for its latest iPhone updates.
(-) Activision Blizzard ( ATVI ) slid as much as 13% Friday after saying it was ending its partnership with game design and development firm Bungle and will not realize any material revenue or operating income from the Destiny game franchise in 2019.
